nodes.label: build.py
nodes.desc: PEP 517/660 surface: build_wheel, build_sdist, build_editable plus get_requires_for_build_*; metadata hooks are conditionally defined when pip's build tracker is absent.

nodes.label: ouroboros.py
nodes.desc: Self-build backend: star-imports hatchling.build and returns its own dependency array by regex-matching pyproject.toml then literal_eval.

nodes.label: BuilderInterface
nodes.desc: Generic ABC: build() validates metadata, resolves versions, runs hook initialize/finalize around version_api callables and yields artifacts.

nodes.label: WheelBuilder
nodes.desc: standard + editable versions; WheelArchive streams files with sha256 digests into the csv-written RECORD; editable installs delegate to the editables package.

nodes.label: SdistBuilder
nodes.desc: Tarball target writing PKG-INFO and an optional legacy setup.py; reuses the same file-selection recursion as the wheel builder.

nodes.label: BinaryBuilder
nodes.desc: PLUGIN_NAME='binary' with a single 'bootstrap' version: compiles a standalone executable by running cargo install pyapp with PYAPP_PROJECT_* env vars set.

nodes.label: CustomBuilder
nodes.desc: Loads a user-supplied builder class from a configured Python file for one-off packaging needs.

nodes.label: BuilderConfig
nodes.desc: Normalizes include/exclude/packages/only-include selection, packages resolution, reproducible flag and env-var overrides.

nodes.label: builders/utils.py
nodes.desc: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH default 1580601600, urlsafe sha256 formatting, and 644/755 permission normalization for reproducible archives.

nodes.label: BuildHookInterface
nodes.desc: Per-target hook contract receiving build_data: initialize, finalize, clean and artifacts/force_include mutation.

nodes.label: CustomBuildHook
nodes.desc: Instantiates a hook class from a user path so projects can run bespoke code inside hatchling builds.

nodes.label: VersionHook
nodes.desc: Writes the resolved version into configured files at build time (build hook named 'version').

nodes.label: MetadataHookInterface
nodes.desc: updates() contract allowing hooks to inject extra [project] metadata before validation.

nodes.label: CustomMetadataHook
nodes.desc: Runs arbitrary project code to update metadata tables dynamically.

nodes.label: PluginManager
nodes.desc: pluggy.PluginManager('hatch') with __getattr__ magic mapping hatch_register_* names to bundled module registration and ClassRegister lookups.

nodes.label: hatchling specs
nodes.desc: Hookspecs: hatch_register_builder, build_hook, metadata_hook and version_source.

nodes.label: Hatch PluginManager
nodes.desc: Extends the hatchling manager with environment, environment_collector, publisher, template and locker registrations.

nodes.label: hatch specs
nodes.desc: Six CLI-side hookspecs covering environments, collectors, version scheme, publishers, templates and lockers.

nodes.label: ProjectMetadata
nodes.desc: Loads pyproject.toml, applies metadata hooks, resolves [tool.hatch.version] sources and validates PEP 621 fields.

nodes.label: metadata/spec.py
nodes.desc: CoreMetadataConstructors that render the METADATA / PKG-INFO payload per Metadata-Version.

nodes.label: RegexSource
nodes.desc: Reads and rewrites a version string in any file via a configurable pattern; hatchling's own docs use the code source on __about__.py.

nodes.label: CodeSource
nodes.desc: Imports or expression-evaluates the version from a Python file, honoring hatchling's own __about__ style.

nodes.label: StandardScheme
nodes.desc: PEP 440 parsing/validation plus normalize and increment logic used by hatch version.

nodes.label: click root group
nodes.desc: Registers 18 commands and resolves project/config/env context before dispatching; rich traceback handler in main().

nodes.label: Application
nodes.desc: Subclasses hatchling's bridge Application on a rich console: verbosity, color styles, prompts, abort.

nodes.label: hatch new
nodes.desc: Scaffolds projects via the template plugin system, including licenses, tests and CI feature flags.

nodes.label: hatch publish
nodes.desc: Uploads built artifacts through publisher plugins with keyring-backed authentication.

nodes.label: publish/index.py
nodes.desc: Package-index publisher streaming wheels/sdists as multipart uploads to PyPI-compatible endpoints.

nodes.label: ProjectConfig
nodes.desc: Matrix engine: itertools.product over matrix variables, py/python forced first, matrix-name-format and overrides resolution.

nodes.label: EnvironmentInterface
nodes.desc: Abstract create/remove/exists/install/sync contract with dependency_hash and app status life-cycle context managers.

nodes.label: VirtualEnvironment
nodes.desc: Default env type: virtualenv creation in project-local or isolated storage, .gitignore seeding, uv pip sync support.

nodes.label: SystemEnvironment
nodes.desc: Runs commands directly in the current interpreter for quick one-off tasks.

nodes.label: venv/core.py
nodes.desc: Low-level VirtualEnv and UVVirtualEnv wrappers handling path discovery, activation scripts and creation flags.

nodes.label: python/core.py
nodes.desc: Downloads and manages standalone CPython distributions (python-build-standalone) for hatch python install.
